_doc: The CLOSED per-level override vocabulary (combat/level-picks arc): which game_rules / movement keys the stage plan may override per level, and the numeric band each value must land in. Validation is FAIL-CLOSED in code (rules.py validate_overrides): an unknown key or out-of-band value is dropped with a warning, never applied. target 'movement' keys override PlayerMovementSpec (the level VALIDATES under its own physics); everything else overrides GameRules. NEVER add checkpoint_enemy_reset without fixing its read OUTSIDE run_level (platformer_play.py main() eject purge). water_containment / enemy_water_policy stay un-overridable (they gate generation).
